abstract: To retrospectively analyze the fertility outcomes and prognosis of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) patients, providing a basis for targeted fertility guidance and counseling. 82 GTD patients of childbearing age who received treatment at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of Lanzhou University First Hospital from January 2016 to January 2023 were stratified into re-pregnancy (n = 20) and non-re-pregnancy (n = 33) cohorts based on their pregnancy outcomes. The impacts of various factors on pregnancy outcomes were subsequently evaluated, encompassing the rates of subsequent pregnancies, live births, miscarriages, ectopic pregnancies, and ongoing pregnancies. Finally, logistics regression model was employed to analyze the risk factors affecting re-pregnancy in GTD patients. The study delineated those patients with different GTD pathologies had varying re-pregnancy rates (mole, erosive mole and choriocarcinoma accounted for 66.04%, 30.19% and 3.77%, respectively). Treatment predominantly involved uterine curettage, with fewer cases receiving chemotherapy alone or in conjunction with curettage accounted for 67.92%, 5.66%, and 26.42%, respectively. The average chemotherapy frequency was 4.59 ± 2.43 sessions, and a majority sought reproductive counseling. Re-pregnancy occurred in 37.74% of patients. The live birth rate was 65.00%, with miscarriage and ectopic pregnancy rates at 25.00% and 5.00% respectively. Logistic regression analysis pinpointed the absence of pre-pregnancy counseling as a significant independent risk factor for re-pregnancy in GTD patients (p < 0.05). While chemotherapy may influence ovarian function, with the majority of patients desiring children post-recovery, pregnancy rates remain high. Fertility counseling significantly enhances re-pregnancy success rates in GTD survivors, emphasizing its recommendation for those aiming to conceive post-recovery.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)患者の生殖能転帰と予後を後方視的に分析し、標的化された生殖能指導および相談の基盤を提供する。2016年1月から2023年1月にランゾウ大学第一病院産婦人科で治療を受けた生殖能年齢のGTD患者82例を、妊娠転帰に基づいて再妊娠群(n=20)と非再妊娠群(n=33)に分層した。その後、後続妊娠率、生児出産率、流産率、子宮外妊娠率、および継続妊娠率を包括する妊娠転帰に対する様々な要因の影響を評価した。最後に、ロジスティック回帰モデルを使用してGTD患者の再妊娠に影響する危険因子を分析した。異なるGTD病理を有する患者は異なる再妊娠率を示し、胞状奇胎、びらん性胞状奇胎および絨毛癌がそれぞれ66.04%、30.19%および3.77%を占めた。治療は主に子宮掻爬を含み、化学療法のみまたは掻爬と併用した症例がそれぞれ67.92%、5.66%および26.42%を占めた。平均化学療法頻度は4.59±2.43回であり、大多数が生殖能相談を求めた。37.74%の患者で再妊娠が発生した。生児出産率は65.00%で、流産率および子宮外妊娠率はそれぞれ25.00%および5.00%であった。ロジスティック回帰分析は、妊娠前相談の欠如がGTD患者の再妊娠に対する有意な独立危険因子(p<0.05)であることを特定した。化学療法は卵巣機能に影響を与える可能性があるが、回復後に子どもを望む患者の大多数では、妊娠率は高いままである。生殖能相談はGTD生存者の再妊娠成功率を著しく向上させ、回復後に妊娠を目指す患者への推奨を強調している。
